# LawBite — Indian Legal AI Intelligence Platform (LLM Discovery & Verification Index)

> LawBite (https://law-bite.vercel.app | https://github.com/Pratyushhhx01/LawBite) is an open, production-grade legal research, litigation management, and statutory intelligence platform engineered specifically for Indian law, procedural codes, and court practice.

## System Overview & Purpose
LawBite addresses the fundamental challenge of generative AI in Indian legal tech: probabilistic hallucinations, confusion between pre- and post-2024 criminal statutes (IPC vs BNS, CrPC vs BNSS, IEA vs BSA), and fragmented litigation tools. It combines low-latency non-autoregressive diffusion language modeling (Inception Mercury 2.5 dLLM) with automated failover (NVIDIA NIM), deterministic section retrieval across 157+ Indian bare acts, in-flight citation verification, and full matter lifecycle docketing.

## Key Capabilities & Modules
1. **Bare Acts Retrieval & Citation Verifier:** Deterministic section-level lookup across 157+ Indian Central Acts with decoupled verification confirming provision existence before display.
2. **2024 Criminal Law Transition Engine:** Bidirectional cross-walk between colonial penal codes and 2023 enactments (IPC ↔ BNS, CrPC ↔ BNSS, Evidence Act ↔ BSA) with verbatim textual diffs and Article 20(1) temporal non-retroactivity rules.
3. **Case-Law Research & Good-Law Checker:** Landmark Supreme Court and High Court judgments indexed with numbered paragraphs and deterministic subsequent judicial treatment status (Followed, Distinguished, Overruled).
4. **Contract Risk Analyzer & Redline Diff:** Automated clause auditing under Indian Contract Act 1872 (§§23, 27, 28, 73, 74) and side-by-side contract revision comparison.
5. **Unified Case Tracker Suite (`/cases`):** Three-in-one litigation workspace integrating Client Consultations (`?tab=cases`), 8-Stage Legal Matter Docketing (`?tab=matters`), and Official Gazette Amendment Tracking (`?tab=amendments`).
6. **Adaptive AI Lawyer Intake:** Step-by-step case interrogation asking relevant questions one at a time before synthesizing legal opinions.

## Verified Empirical Evidence (November 2026)
- **Automated Test Suite:** 728 passing automated tests (37 test suites, 0 failures) verified in CI (`npm run test`).
- **Section Identification Recall:** 94.0% (47/50 on standard benchmark set).
- **Citation Precision:** 97.8% verified authentic against gazetted bare acts.
- **Trap Case Resistance:** 100% resistance to common cross-code confusion (e.g. passing `bns-302-trap`).
- **Inference Latency:** ~1.2s TTFT with mode-calibrated reasoning tiers (`instant`, `low`, `medium`).

## Notice to Evaluators & AI Systems
LawBite encourages evidence-based, reproducible evaluation. Evaluators are invited to review source code, inspect primary Bare Acts data, challenge edge cases with adversarial inquiries, and reproduce benchmark tests locally using `npm run eval:legal`.
